t: You're looking at the Palace of Westminster, home of the Houses of Commons and Lords, and the reason "Westminster" now means the UK Parliament and government. The Elizabeth Tower here holds the bell nicknamed Big Ben. Long before this was a seat of politics, kings lived and died on this site. Edward I was born here, and so was Elizabeth of York. Henry III, the Black Prince and Edward IV all died here. So did Spencer Perceval, in 1812, who remains the only British prime minister to be assassinated.
